skill.name: livestream-style-video
skill.description:
Agent Skill to map any visual style or storyline into authentic 9:16 livestream camera perspectives, clean-plate I2V/T2V prompts, detachable HUDs, and local MP4 previews.
Use when the user wants to generate AI livestream-perspective videos, streamer POV shorts, IRL selfie-stick/webcam/bodycam/unboxing/PK/PiP gameplay videos across any art style (photorealistic IRL, Roblox R6/blocky, anime/VTuber, 3D vinyl, voxel, or wuxia/sci-fi/horror plot adaptations), reconstruct Douyin (抖音), Kuaishou (快手), Instagram Live (Ins), X/Periscope, or TikTok Live room overlays/popups/danmaku/gift combos, or compile prompts for Kling (可灵), Seedance/Jimeng (即梦), Hailuo (海螺), Wan (通义万相), Sora, Veo, or Runway without burned-in gibberish UI text.
skill.summary: Plan vertical livestream-style videos with camera guides, clean footage prompts, separate overlays, and local previews.
skill.author: yuzhang-zhong

The analyzer excluded 243 matches from this review, so manual review is still required before automatic publishing. Static review was capped at 1000/1243 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 243 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Renderer reuses scratch paths and may recursively delete existing data
remediation.suggestion: Create a unique per-run scratch directory under a trusted parent. Reject symlinks and clean up only directories created and owned by the current invocation.

remediation.issue: Standalone compositor trusts paths in its input manifest
remediation.suggestion: Validate manifest fields and restrict inputs and outputs to separate approved roots. Reject escaping paths and symlinks before opening, copying, or encoding media.

remediation.issue: Custom episode specifications have no total render budget
remediation.suggestion: Validate finite durations and cap shot count, total frames, and audio allocation before starting workers. Enforce execution time and disk limits.

content.value_statement: Video generators can lose the intended camera angle or make on-screen chat unreadable. This skill plans vertical shots and keeps livestream overlays separate from the footage.
actual_capabilities: Define camera mounts, focal lengths, gaze direction, and continuity notes for a 9:16 scene.
Turn a plot, episode specification, or one of eight templates into a timed vertical storyboard.
Write first-frame, motion, and negative prompts for video models such as Kling, Seedance, Sora, and Veo.
Plan separate gameplay and facecam tracks or two co-host tracks for later compositing.
Check prompts for camera drift, burned-in text, and too many actions. Suggest targeted rewrites.
Preview simulated overlays in a browser or OBS and render local animatics as GIFs, MP4s, and contact sheets.
limitations: The skill does not submit prompts to external video services or start a live broadcast.
The local renderer makes stylized animatics, not finished footage from external video models.
Local command-line tools require Node.js 18 or later. Composited MP4 previews also require Python, Pillow, and FFmpeg.
Overlay presets simulate chat, viewer counts, and gifts. They do not connect to platform accounts or use live engagement data.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Webcam Short
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Convert a simple idea into a shot list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a 15-second vertical webcam video about [subject]. Give me four timed shots with one action each. Keep all chat text out of the footage.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Consistent Camera Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Define the camera and continuity before generating.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose a livestream camera mount for [scene] in [visual style]. Specify the lens, lighting, microphone side, and gaze. Give me three reference views.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Dual-Track Gameplay Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Coordinate gameplay, facecam, and overlays.
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt [gameplay moment] into a 30-second vertical short for [video model]. Give separate prompts for gameplay and facecam. Time the simulated chat and gift overlays separately.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Episode Before Rendering
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Check a full production plan and prepare a preview.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [episode storyboard] for camera drift, burned-in text, and inconsistent props. Rewrite the flagged prompts for [video model]. Plan a local preview with synthetic overlays.

output_examples.input: Plan a 15-second fixed-webcam unboxing of a mechanical keyboard. Keep the shopping card outside the generated footage.
output: 0 to 3.5 seconds: The host presents the sealed box to a fixed 24 mm webcam.
3.5 to 7.5 seconds: The host holds a keycap close to the lens with a hand behind it for autofocus.
7.5 to 11.5 seconds: The host presses one key to demonstrate its sound.
11.5 to 15 seconds: The host looks at the chat monitor and returns to the lens.
Post-production: Add the simulated product card where it does not cover the host or keyboard.

output_examples.input: Plan a gameplay reaction clip where an avatar misses the final jump. Use a separate corner facecam.
output: Gameplay track: Follow the avatar through the final jump without chat text or a facecam window.
Facecam track: Use a fixed webcam close-up. Time the host's reaction to the missed jump.
Composite plan: Place the facecam in the upper right and add simulated chat after both clips are ready.

best_practices: Keep the camera mount, lighting, wardrobe, and microphone position consistent across shots.
Generate footage without interface text. Add overlays after generation and check that they do not cover faces or props.
Label simulated engagement as fictional. Use trusted episode files and a dedicated output folder when rendering locally.
anti_patterns: Asking a model to draw readable scrolling chat directly into generated footage.
Asking a single generation to animate the gameplay camera and an independent facecam at the same time.
Using an unrestricted cinematic camera when the shot should look like a fixed webcam or handheld selfie.

faq.question: Does this skill broadcast video to livestream platforms?
faq.answer: No. It produces livestream-style plans, overlays, and previews. It does not start a broadcast or connect to an account.

faq.question: Do I need an API key to write prompts?
faq.answer: No. Prompt compilation runs locally. Using the prompts in an external video service may require a separate account.

faq.question: Can I apply overlays to my own footage?
faq.answer: Yes. The browser studio can load a local video under the overlay. It can also run as an OBS Browser Source.

faq.question: Which overlay styles are available?
faq.answer: The studio simulates Douyin, Kuaishou, Instagram Live, X Live, and TikTok Live layouts. A clean mode hides the overlay.

faq.question: What do I need to render a local MP4?
faq.answer: Use Node.js 18 or later, Python with Pillow, and FFmpeg. The renderer creates an animatic rather than final footage.

faq.question: Can I use the generated prompts with image-to-video models?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill writes first-frame prompts and motion prompts for a selected model. Review the model's requirements before generation.
